description: An amortization schedule shows how each monthly payment splits into interest and principal and what balance is left, and this tool lists it month by month (up to 600 rows) with totals. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

payment.description: Monthly payment if not fully amortizing (the last row then clears the remainder).

name: amortization_schedule
title: Amortization schedule calculator
